devdoc.details: A contract that facilitates communication between the Ethereum mainnet and  the Arbitrum Layer 2 network by handling incoming and outgoing messages through the Arbitrum Sys contract.  Inherits from NativeSwitchboardBase contract that handles communication with  other Layer 1 networks.

AlreadyInitialized().details: Error thrown when the contract has already been initialized.

FeesNotEnough().details: Error thrown when the fees provided are not enough to execute the transaction.

InvalidNonce().details: Error thrown when the nonce of the signature is invalid.

InvalidSender().details: Error thrown when the root receive transaction is not sent by a valid sender. i.e. native bridge contract

InvalidTokenAddress().details: thrown when the given token address don't have any code

NoPermit(bytes32).details: Error message thrown when an address does not have permission to execute a function with onlyRole modifier.

NoRootFound().details: Error thrown when a root hash cannot be found for the given packet ID.

UnequalArrayLengths().details: thrown when array lengths are not equal

GlobalTripChanged(bool).details: Event emitted when the switchboard trip status changes

InitiatedNativeConfirmation(bytes32).details: Event emitted when a packet root relay via native bridge is initialised

RoleGranted(bytes32,address).details: Emitted when a role is granted to an address.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address).details: Emitted when a role is revoked from an address.

RootReceived(bytes32,bytes32).details: Event emitted when a root is received via native bridge.

params.packetId: The unique identifier of the packet.
params.root: The root hash of the packet.

SwitchboardFeesSet(uint256,uint256).details: Emitted when a fees is set for switchboard

UpdatedRemoteNativeSwitchboard(address).details: This event is emitted when this switchboard wants to connect with its sibling on other chain.

params.remoteNativeSwitchboard: address of switchboard on sibling chain.

params.packetId: The unique identifier for the packet.
params.proposalCount: The unique identifier for a proposal for the packet.
params.proposeTime: The time when the packet was proposed.
params.srcChainSlug: The unique identifier for the source chain of the packet.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the packet is allowed to go through the switchboard or not.

claimOwner().details: Allows the nominated owner to claim ownership of the contract. Throws an error if the caller is not the nominee. Sets the nominated owner as the new owner of the contract. Emits an `OwnerClaimed` event with the address of the new owner.

constructor.details: Constructor function that sets initial values for the arbsys__, and the NativeSwitchboardBase parent contract.

params.chainSlug_: A uint32 representing the ID of the L2 network.
params.owner_: The address that will have the default admin role in the AccessControl parent contract.
params.socket_: The address of the Ethereum mainnet Native Meta-Transaction Executor contract.

getMinFees(uint32).details: Get the minimum fees for a cross-chain transaction.

returns.switchboardFee_: The fee charged by the switchboard for the transaction.
returns.verificationFee_: The fee charged by the verifier for the transaction.

grantBatchRole(bytes32[],uint32[],addres.details: Grants multiple roles to multiple addresses in batch.

params.grantees_: The addresses to be granted the roles.
params.roleNames_: The names of the roles to grant.
params.slugs_: The slugs for chain specific roles. For roles which are not chain-specific, we can use slug = 0

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants a role to a given address.

params.grantee_: The address to grant the role to. Emits a RoleGranted event. Can only be called by the owner of the contract.

grantRoleWithSlug(bytes32,uint32,address.details: Grants a role to an address based on the role name and chain slug.

params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.
params.grantee_: The address to be granted the role.

hasRole(bytes32,address).details: Checks whether an address has a specific role.

returns._0: A boolean value indicating whether or not the address has the role.

hasRoleWithSlug(bytes32,uint32,address).details: Checks if an address has a role based on the role name and chain slug.

params.address_: The address to check for the role.
params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the address has the specified role.

initiateNativeConfirmation(bytes32).details: Sends a message to the L1 network requesting a confirmation for the packet with the specified packet ID.

params.packetId_: A bytes32 representing the ID of the packet to be confirmed.

nominateOwner(address).details: Allows the current owner to nominate a new owner for the contract. Throws an error if the caller is not the owner. Emits an `OwnerNominated` event with the address of the nominee.

nominee().details: Returns the current nominee for ownership of the contract.

owner().details: Returns the current owner of the contract.

params.siblingChainSlug_: the chain slug of the sibling chain.

receivePacket(bytes32,bytes32).details: this function is not used by polygon native bridge, it works by calling a different function.

params.root_: root for the given packet ID

registerSiblingSlug(uint32,uint256,uint2.details: This function is expected to be only called by admin as it handles the capacitor config for given chain

params.capacitorType_: The type of capacitor that the switchboard uses.
params.initialPacketCount_: The packet count at the time of registering switchboard. Packets with packet count below this won't be allowed
params.maxPacketLength_: The maximum length of a packet allowed by the switchboard.
params.siblingChainSlug_: The slug of the sibling chain to register switchboard with.

params.amount_: The amount of tokens to be rescued.
params.rescueTo_: The address where rescued tokens need to be sent.
params.token_: The address of the token contract.

revokeBatchRole(bytes32[],uint32[],addre.details: Revokes multiple roles from multiple addresses in batch.

params.grantees_: The addresses to be revoked the roles.
params.roleNames_: The names of the roles to revoke.
params.slugs_: The slugs for chain specific roles. For roles which are not chain-specific, we can use slug = 0

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes a role from a given address.

params.revokee_: The address to revoke the role from. Emits a RoleRevoked event. Can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.
params.grantee_: The addresses to be revoked the roles.
params.roleName_: The names of the roles to revoke.

setFees(uint256,uint32,uint128,uint128,b.details: not important to override in all switchboards

params.dstChainSlug_: the unique identifier for the destination chain.
params.nonce_: the nonce of fee Updater to avoid replay.
params.switchboardFees_: the switchboard fee required for the destination chain to process the packet.
params.verificationOverheadFees_: the verification fee required for the destination chain to process the packet.

tripGlobal(uint256,bytes).details: The function recovers the signer from the given signature and verifies if the signer has the TRIP_ROLE.      The nonce must be equal to the next nonce of the caller. If the caller doesn't have the TRIP_ROLE or the nonce      is incorrect, it will revert.       Once the function is successful, the isGlobalTipped variable is set to true and the GlobalTripChanged event is emitted.

unTrip(uint256,bytes).details: To un trip, the untripper must have the UN_TRIP_ROLE.

params.nonce_: The nonce to prevent replay attacks.
params.signature_: The signature created by the untripper.

updateSibling(uint32,address).details: This function is expected to be only called by admin

params.siblingChainSlug_: The slug of the sibling chain to register switchboard with.

withdrawFees(address).details: The caller must have the WITHDRAW_ROLE.

params.withdrawTo_: The address of the account to withdraw fees to.

devdoc.title: ArbitrumL2Switchboard

allowPacket(bytes32,bytes32,uint256,uint.notice: Checks if a packet can be allowed to go through the switchboard.

receiveFees(uint32).notice: Receives the fees for processing of packet.

receivePacket(bytes32,bytes32).notice: records the root for a given packet ID sent by a remote switchboard via native bridge

registerSiblingSlug(uint32,uint256,uint2.notice: Registers itself in Socket for given `siblingChainSlug_`.

rescueFunds(address,address,uint256).notice: Rescues funds from the contract if they are locked by mistake.

setFees(uint256,uint32,uint128,uint128,b.notice: Sets the minimum fees required for the destination chain to process the packet.

tripGlobal(uint256,bytes).notice: Allows to trip the global fuse and prevent the switchboard to process packets

unTrip(uint256,bytes).notice: Allows a untripper to un trip the switchboard by providing a signature and a nonce.

updateSibling(uint32,address).notice: Updates the sibling switchboard for given `siblingChainSlug_`.

withdrawFees(address).notice: Allows the withdrawal of fees by the account with the specified address.
